outcome: candidate corrected, winding semantics updated, and independently verified
findings_and_fixes: Replaced quadratic linear vertex lookup with deterministic canonical grid-vertex/edge-crossing keys and ordered caches.
Clips two triangles per cell; ambiguous diagonal wet-corner cases split along the dry diagonal to avoid fan bridges.
Rejects grids over 65,536 cells before sample allocation; hard caps output at 16 vertices and 24 indices per cell.

Uses 28 deterministic bisection steps per cached wet/dry edge crossing. This approximates the boolean wet boundary; it is not an analytic water/terrain intersection because ReferenceLandscape::height includes step noise.

Both the visible surface and bed use conventional +Y domain winding so the creek substrate remains visible from above. The Wicked adapter uses reversed normal cross-product order and must reverse indices for upward host-facing normals.

verification.output: shore_mesh: shoreline mesh suite passed at 4.0m and 0.75m (65,536-cell limit); 0.1m over-budget request rejected before allocation. Bed and surface both assert +Y domain winding.
